domain: electron microscopy of polycrystalline thin films

nodes.desc: read the particle table (detector_params.json) and the sample metadata
correct the detector gain drift from the metadata when it is recorded
assign detected particles to crystallite nuclei
held-out crystallite labels for the hidden input sets
score the submitted matches against the held-out labels

generator_assumptions.where: each true crystallite is matched to the predicted nucleus that contains the largest number of its particles
the detector gain is taken as unity when the metadata leaves it unset
recovered from data: the median of the lowest-signal decile of the measured intensities
